goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann eigene Entscheidungen hinsichtlich rationaler Kriterien kritisch beurteilen und systematische Einflüsse begrenzter Rationalität erklären.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: The same identifiable shopper appears in two hypothetical impulse/weighing situations, preserving identity and dignity. An urgency banner and anchor-shaped tag are contrasted with needs/budget/benefit consideration; reflection is not shown as a guarantee that bias disappears. The right person's held checklist, however, displays its written front toward audience rather than the reader.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px impulse versus weighing labels, urgency cue, same person and the changed comparison situation remain recognisable; tiny checklist words are supplementary.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the two comparison products, deliberate pause and criteria checklist are clear, but the read-facing paper orientation is incorrect.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The right-hand actor looks toward a held checklist whose text front faces the audience while the person is behind it. The supposed reader would see its back rather than the shown criteria.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

blockingFindings.description: The held criteria checklist is displayed to the audience rather than oriented for its apparent reader.
blockingFindings.targetedCorrection: Turn the held block toward the reader, showing its back to audience; preserve reflection criteria separately as thought icons if needed. Keep the same actor and both purchase situations.

interpretationLimits: The two states are hypothetical and do not diagnose a bias from one observed purchase. Comparing deliberately does not guarantee complete rationality.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
